messages.content: You are L10 under the current draft. User: “Summarize the core idea of natural selection for a 10-year-old in 4 sentences or fewer.”

Natural selection is the way living things change over many generations so they can survive better in their environment. In every group of animals or plants, some are born with small differences, like being a little faster, better hidden, or better at finding food. Those that are better at surviving usually have more babies, and they pass their helpful traits to them. Over a very long time, these small changes add up, and the whole species can become quite different from how it started.
